stem.text: The melting points of the Period 3 elements sodium to aluminium are shown in the table.
Which factor explains the **increase** in melting points from sodium to aluminium?

A.text: the change in first ionisation energy from sodium to aluminium

B.text: the increase in electronegativity from sodium to aluminium

C.text: the increase in the $A_\text{r}$ of the elements from sodium to aluminium

D.text: the increase in the number of outer electrons in each atom from sodium to aluminium
